objective: Stop the register's unfiled list offering one change request twice or offering withdrawn ones. server/services/register/unfiled.ts: `push` (~L53-56) only checks `filed` (links already filed), not items already pushed; the change-request loop (~L75) pushes each CHANGE_REQUEST and the software-request loop (~L104-110) pushes the same `request.changeRequestId` again; and the WITHDRAWN skip at ~L76 is not applied on the software-request path. Fix: add a `seen` set so push refuses a repeated `kind:ref`; build a map of change-request id -> state from listChangeRequests and skip a software request whose change request is WITHDRAWN; when both paths name one change request keep the software request's title (the richer one), e.g. by running the software-request loop first. CLAUDE.md §43: unfiled is derived, offered, never filed.
expectedOutcome: Each change request appears at most once in unfiled work, and withdrawn ones never appear.
nonGoals: Any route, schema or client change

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/registerUnfiledDedup.test.ts: a software request linked to a live change request produces exactly one CHANGE_REQUEST unfiled item.
A software request linked to a WITHDRAWN change request produces no CHANGE_REQUEST item.
tests/workRegister.test.ts still passes and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; one service function plus one new test.
